details: The U.S. Treasury's expanded buyback program for longer-dated bonds has injected significant liquidity into financial markets, bolstering risk appetite among investors. This move is largely credited with fueling Bitcoin's recent surge, with the cryptocurrency climbing over 20% this week to reach its highest levels since May.
title: US Treasury Buybacks Spark Crypto Rally Amid Increased Liquidity

details: Bitcoin's recent breakout is strongly linked to improving U.S. regulatory sentiment, according to analysts at Citi. Key factors include the SEC's proposed "Regulation Crypto Assets" framework and renewed political support, with President Trump backing the CLARITY Act. These developments are seen as more sustainable drivers for crypto than general macroeconomic concerns.
title: US Regulatory Momentum and Clarity Drive Bitcoin's Surge

details: Crypto investors are closely monitoring upcoming U.S. economic releases, including Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation, GDP growth, and jobs data. Hotter-than-expected inflation or robust growth/labor figures could pressure expectations for future interest rate cuts, potentially introducing volatility and challenging the recent crypto market rally.
title: PCE Inflation, GDP, Jobs Data Loom as Key Crypto Market Catalysts

details: Long-end U.S. Treasury yields have rebounded, with the 10-year yield reaching approximately 4.70% and the 30-year yield recovering to about 5.25%. Concurrently, escalating tensions between the U.S. and Iran are driving energy prices higher. These macro pressures have weighed on equity markets, yet Bitcoin has continued its rally, breaking above $70K, indicating strong underlying buying momentum despite broader market headwinds.
title: Rising Yields & Iran Tensions Pressure Markets, Crypto Shows Resilience
